_meta.lookup: From a mission marker line (generator name [<G>], contract [<C>]) and the notice title, the first of these that answers gives kind, view and setting: (1) contracts[C]; if C is missing and ends in "_<n>", contracts[<C without it>] when that entry has subs > n (sub-contracts are logged as <name>_<index>, from 0); if the entry has `also` and G is one of those generators, that one; (2) generators[G] when it has a `view` (all its contracts agree); (3) titles[title], then the first title_patterns regex that matches; (4) the first of `rules` whose pattern matches C or G (in that order per rule); (5) kind "unknown", view "mission". Anything that lands on (5) goes to data/unmapped.json. `setting`: foot, ship, vehicle or null (not settled); for combat it comes from what the mission spawns (people only: foot; ships only: ship). `types` names the game's mission types. `rules_check` is how the fallback rules alone do on this build's contracts.
